operations.description: List one object type's records (contacts, companies, deals, tickets or any other type the account has), one page per call; the walk sends paging.next.after as after and ends on a page without paging.next
Read one record by objectType and objectId; properties and associations are comma-separated lists

List the account's owners (the users and queues a hubspot_owner_id names), with name, email and teams, one page per call; the walk sends paging.next.after as after and ends on a page without paging.next
Read one owner by the id a record's hubspot_owner_id carries (or by userId with idProperty userId); answers name, email and teams
